experience.title: Data Architect & BI Consultant
experience.summary: Lead end-to-end data architecture, integration, and orchestration across retail, chemicals, energy, and transport. Deliver scalable BI, cloud data pipelines, and event-driven integrations for enterprise clients.
impact: Established best practices for event-driven architectures and data orchestration across heterogeneous systems.
Delivered cloud-native pipelines (GCP, Azure, Snowflake, Fabric), enabling scalable analytics and near real-time reporting.
Technical lead on delivery and business development: As-Is assessments and Board-ready proposals on Fabric and GCP, plus architectural blueprints and reusable frameworks.

projects.summary: Led as PM-Tech Lead. Deployment of the Microsoft Fabric infrastructure and migration of the data architecture, alongside Dynamics 365: medallion layers, a dbt project (60+ Silver models and Gold dimensions), and ingestion notebooks for Eurostat, AEMET and CBOT.
projects.outcome: Fabric infrastructure and the migrated architecture in production, with customer, financial and product data, and CI/CD for dbt and SQL Warehouses.

proposal.label: Commercial proposal
proposal.summary: Led as PM-Tech Lead. Board-ready proposal for an operational integration backbone on the Fabric platform deployed in 2026: an operational canonical model, an event engine, an Operational Data Hub, edge and transaction planes, Dynamics readiness, and a governed path to agents.
proposal.outcome: Implementation is expected in 2027, as a stop-and-go programme that reuses the analytical canon already in production instead of rebuilding it.

projects.summary: Led as PM-Tech Lead. As-Is assessment of a Power BI and Fabric PPU estate (44 workspaces, 514 artefacts) with no medallion layer, and a To-Be proposal to migrate toward the same DDP-DataOS pattern used at DACSA.
projects.outcome: An evidence-based baseline of usage, gateways, ownership and debt used to justify the DataOS migration. The medallion platform is proposed, not deployed.

projects.summary: Led as PM-Tech Lead. Delivery design for governed AI reporting on the existing Financial DWH in BigQuery: a semantic layer and Dataplex catalog, SELECT-only text-to-SQL agents, versioned report generation, and a portal that serves dashboards without an AI cost per view.
projects.outcome: A four-block plan from discovery to go-live that replaces uncontrolled GenAI self-service with a platform controlled by IT. Design and estimate, not a completed go-live.

projects.summary: Led as PM-Tech Lead. Financial planning and analysis for the group's finance arm, about 40 companies. Minerva loads Excel templates and masters from SharePoint, orchestrates ingestion in Azure Data Factory, transforms them through a Databricks medallion, and refreshes Power BI.
projects.outcome: Business users run PROCESS, REPROCESS or DELETE by company, year, month and concept from a Canvas App, with Power Automate calling the pipelines.

projects.summary: Led as PM-Tech Lead. Customer master integration between Salesforce and the Data Hub (ODH/SAP): a canonical JSON model and a custom Java JSON utility library (2,500+ lines) driving Talend read, write, backfill and CDC.
projects.outcome: Traceable bidirectional sync across Data Hub, CRM and ERP, using structural comparison to choose POST or PATCH.

projects.summary: Migration of the GPC_Tous data platform: FastAPI APIs for recommendations, cart and wishlist, a repository pattern with multi-level cache, and metadata-driven Airflow DAGs defined in YAML.
projects.outcome: 27+ pipelines moved onto a layered platform, with lower API latency and shorter DAG runtime.

projects.summary: Analysis of the FyM Inmovilizado Power BI semantic model on Snowflake, covering modelling and DAX under high volumetry.
projects.outcome: Ten modelling and DAX anti-patterns documented, with a prioritised optimisation plan and a phased roadmap.

projects.summary: BI and data for sustainability and commercial: corporate sustainability dashboards, a central SSAS Tabular model (Join Life, rankings, composition), a Snowflake data layer, and Power BI reporting for SSP and GTW traceability, with RLS and data governance.
projects.outcome: One analytical model and operational reports, with legacy DB2 and Oracle sources migrated to Snowflake under validation.

personalProjects.title: MDIF — Metadata-Driven Ingestion Framework
personalProjects.description: Framework for automated migration and ingestion across PostgreSQL, MySQL and Snowflake. Declarative YAML config, schema discovery from INFORMATION_SCHEMA, idempotent DDL with type mapping, and batch or cursor-based incremental loads orchestrated in Airflow.
personalProjects.outcome: A single config drives discovery, DDL and load, and re-runs stay idempotent.

personalProjects.title: Laboratory — Proxmox to Kubernetes
personalProjects.description: The host tools. Each workload runs on its own. The same lab provides remote access, name resolution and the public entry. A workload proved here is published by a deployment gateway, first onto a three-node Kubernetes cluster and then to a commercial provider.
personalProjects.outcome: The tools a workload is proved on before it is published to a commercial provider.

personalProjects.title: Data Platform
personalProjects.description: The data tools: capture of changes, an immutable history, the current state and the prepared views. Each application sees only its own data.
personalProjects.outcome: The central point of the data, for audit, analytical use and ML training. DataHub on 126 keeps the lineage and the data catalog of each application and each tenant.

personalProjects.title: ML training lab
personalProjects.description: Trains on the prepared views of the Data Platform: a day in the vineyard, and a tank and a lot through the hour. It reads that prepared data and writes the model as its own result, leaving the history and every other product's data as they are. The place is reserved. The first finished model is still ahead.
personalProjects.outcome: A model is trained from the platform's prepared data and stored as its own result.

personalProjects.title: Agents
personalProjects.description: The agent tools of the lab: OpenCode and Cursor. OpenCode runs the operating routine of the node — look, diagnose, change, check and record. Cursor is the workstation where the products are written.
personalProjects.outcome: The lab is operated, and the products are written, with these two agents.

personalProjects.title: Electronics lab
personalProjects.description: An interest in telemetry, and the exploration that follows it. A new Proxmox node and an electronics lab, now being equipped, will take the products into telemetry, near real-time (NRT) data and streaming. The first bench is ESP32-S3 boards, with level shifting and an isolated serial link, reading tank level, liquid flow, distance and climate.
personalProjects.outcome: Each product gets a place to try its own sensors, near real-time data and streams.

personalProjects.title: Winery platform
personalProjects.description: The day-to-day of a winery, from the vine and the cellar to the bottled lot, then stock, billing and the next customer. Staff work the vineyard, the cellar and the operations, and each lot keeps its genealogy. A staff portal and a Telegram agent share the same door, and an order is created only after a person confirms it. A prospect arrives with a status. Delivery, invoice and payment stay separate steps, so a sale is recorded before the wine has left and before it has been paid. The commercial site and a broker variant are built and waiting. This operation is the live reading on the Data Platform.
personalProjects.outcome: Sensors feed the vineyard and cellar work, and every operation stays traceable from the grape through vinification to the bottled lot.

personalProjects.title: Boat Assistant
personalProjects.description: The intelligence of a connected boat. Sensors, weather and alarms reach a helm the skipper can still use with no internet. The boat in the lab speaks the same language the hardware will, so what is tried here is the product that goes on board. Advice from a model stays advice: a critical alarm is raised by rules on the boat itself. The history of each trip is ready to land on the Data Platform.
personalProjects.outcome: A skipper can run the boat from a local helm, and that history is ready for the shared data platform.
